content.text: There are trips not only to explore, but also to share.
TodayTourist honors traveling with young children at the Upper Roof of the Heart – orphans, disabled and in special circumstances – on a day of pleasure, a full sea bath at KDL Wind Lake.
Each one of them is a force for greater love.
Thank you from the heart, KDan Feng Hu and two coaches, and Mr. Wentai's dedicated companion, which contributed to a full and full day of joy.
TodayTourist believes that the most meaningful journey is the journey that brings happiness to others.
